failures.rule: product/ui-constitution.md, Article 2.4 (what a first-time user will misread), Article 7 (familiar patterns); brand/constitution.md, E3 (honest claims).
failures.place: Arrow from the middle screen’s Print label button to the right-hand Shipping / On its way screen.
failures.issue: The depicted transition makes printing a label appear to put the parcel on its way. No handoff or shipment event is shown between those states. As an annotated experience board, it communicates a misleading consequence for the action.

failures.rule: brand/ledger.md, D6 (all options specify 50) and A3 (sizes by role); brand/constitution.md, Article 6.2, Part IV B14 and B28.
